name: vwap_overshoot_fade_001
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index drifts 0.3%+ below (or above) session VWAP in a low-ADX tape, the move is driven by algorithmic momentum triggers and retail chase flow — not institutional directional conviction. RSI(24) (a 2-minute exhaustion read at 5s bars) hitting below 15 or above 85 signals that micro-momentum is fully spent and no new sellers/buyers are stepping in. VWAP-benchmarked institutional desks then begin rebalancing aggressively — fills at 0.3% from VWAP give them significant benchmark outperformance, creating strong buy/sell pressure back toward VWAP. The low ADX(36) filter (3-minute trend strength < 22) ensures no large TWAP/VWAP execution is underway, which would override the reversion tendency.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP resets each session — no scaling needed. This is the fair value anchor. NIFTY's institutional VWAP-benchmarked algos create strong magnetic pull at deviations > 0.3% because every fill closer to VWAP improves their benchmark performance.

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: RSI(24) = 24 × 5s = 2 minutes — preserves the EXACT same time window as RSI(2) on 1-minute bars in the original (2 × 1-min = 2 min). We are not scaling by 12x; we are mapping the same 2-minute exhaustion window. RSI(2) in the original fires when just 2 consecutive 1-min candles are strongly directional; RSI(24) over 2 minutes detects the same sustained micro-trend at 5s resolution.

indicators.name: adx_36
indicators.purpose: ADX(36) = 36 × 5s = 3 minutes. The original used ADX(14) on 1-min = 14 minutes. We COMPRESS to 3 minutes because our hold time is 15-90s — we need the CURRENT 3-minute regime, not what the market was doing 14 minutes ago. ADX < 22 at 3-minute resolution indicates no active institutional directional program running, which is the necessary condition for VWAP reversion to dominate.

conditions: vwap_dev < -0.003 (NIFTY >= 0.3% below session VWAP, ~67 pts at 22500)
rsi_24 < 15.0 (2-minute RSI exhausted to oversold extreme)
adx_36 < 22 (3-minute tape is range-bound, no active directional flow)
buy_ce.confirmation: All three conditions simultaneously in early session

conditions: vwap_dev > 0.003 (NIFTY >= 0.3% above session VWAP, ~67 pts at 22500)
rsi_24 > 85.0 (2-minute RSI exhausted to overbought extreme)
adx_36 < 22 (3-minute tape is range-bound, no active directional flow)
buy_pe.confirmation: All three conditions simultaneously in early session

exit.stop_rationale: If NIFTY moves another 8 spot points FURTHER from VWAP after entry (4 option pts at delta ~0.5), the overshoot is news-driven or has broken the range-bound thesis — at a 30-second horizon, 8 additional spot points signals the RSI exhaustion read was wrong. NIFTY 15-30s moves are typically 1-3 pts in range-bound conditions; a 4pt adverse move is a clear thesis invalidation.
exit.target_rationale: A 0.3% NIFTY deviation (~67 pts) in range-bound conditions reverts 30-50% toward VWAP within 60-90 seconds. Capturing 14 spot points (7 option pts at delta ~0.5) is ~20% of the total deviation, which is conservative and reliably achievable — the first leg of VWAP reversion. At 1-minute horizon, typical NIFTY options move 3-7 pts; 7 pts targets the upper end of this range.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 11:15 IST (session_end for this strategy)

filters.vix_filter: none — VIX regime does not differentiate early-session VWAP exhaustion setups
filters.time_filter: 09:20-11:15 IST only — opening inventory correction window; VWAP reversion thesis weakens after 11:15 as price has had time to establish directional trends
filters.volume_filter: implicit via VWAP computation — low-volume bars produce noisy VWAP deviations but the RSI filter handles this

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — works best in choppy open; deteriorates on gap-and-go days when VWAP never gets tested from below

adaptation_notes: Three major changes from the original equity strategy: (1) RSI(2) on 1-min → RSI(24) on 5s: exact same 2-minute window, not a 12x scale. The key is preserving the 'very short-term exhaustion' reading, not the bar count. (2) ADX(14) on 1-min → ADX(36) on 5s: COMPRESSED from 14-min to 3-min because we hold 15-90s. The original's 14-minute ADX was context for a 5-10 min hold; our 3-minute ADX is context for a 15-90s hold — proportionally matched. (3) Relative volume, Bollinger bands, and index-return filter removed: index volume is noisy and incomparable bar-to-bar; Bollinger bands are redundant with VWAP deviation + low ADX; the 'index must be flat' filter from the original cannot apply since we ARE the index — ADX serves the same purpose of ensuring no macro directional flow. VWAP deviation threshold tightened from 0.5% to 0.3% because NIFTY as an index oscillates with smaller per-bar deviations than individual FnO stocks, and 0.3% on NIFTY already represents 67+ spot points — a meaningful overshoot generating 3-5 trades/day in early session.
weaknesses: On gap-and-go days NIFTY may gap away from VWAP and never return in the early session window, generating zero trades
RSI(24) at 5s resolution is sensitive to 2-minute micro-trends; a single large 5s candle can spike RSI above 85 without a genuine exhaustion condition
ADX(36) = 3 minutes may lag actual regime shifts; a breakout can be underway for 30-60s before ADX crosses 22
